name: MGM Resorts International
description: MGM Resorts is a global gaming and hospitality company operating a portfolio of Las Vegas Strip resorts (Bellagio, MGM Grand, Aria, Mandalay Bay, Luxor and others), regional US casinos, MGM China's Macau resorts (MGM Macau and MGM Cotai), and a 50/50 US online sports betting and iGaming joint venture, BetMGM, with Entain. It earns revenue from gaming win, hotel rooms, food & beverage, entertainment and convention business at owned/leased properties, plus its equity share of BetMGM's results. The company reports four segments: Las Vegas Strip Resorts, Regional Operations, MGM China, and MGM Digital.

founded.value: 1986 (as a corporate successor tracing to the historic MGM Grand Hotel/Golden Nugget lineage; modern holding-company structure dates to 2000 MGM Grand Inc./Mirage Resorts merger)

businessLines.name: Las Vegas Strip Resorts
businessLines.description: Portfolio of Strip integrated resorts (Bellagio, ARIA, MGM Grand, Mandalay Bay, Luxor, New York-New York, Park MGM, Excalibur, The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas) combining gaming, rooms, F&B, entertainment and convention space.

businessLines.name: Regional Operations

share.text: estimated high-teens percent of consolidated net revenue (not precisely confirmed)

businessLines.description: US regional casinos outside Las Vegas (e.g., MGM Grand Detroit, Beau Rivage Biloxi, Borgata Atlantic City, MGM National Harbor, Empire City).
businessLines.revenueNote: Full-year segment revenue total not confirmed in this pass; Q3 2025 quarterly Regional net revenue was $957 million vs. $952 million prior-year quarter; full-year 2025 net revenue grew 1% YoY per management commentary. See 10-K segment footnote for exact annual figure.

businessLines.name: MGM China
businessLines.description: Majority-owned (via NYSE American Depositary interest structure and Hong Kong-listed MGM China Holdings) Macau operations: MGM Macau (peninsula) and MGM Cotai.

businessLines.name: MGM Digital (BetMGM)
businessLines.description: US online sports betting and iGaming operated through BetMGM, a 50/50 joint venture with Entain plc; MGM equity-accounts for its share of BetMGM's results within this segment alongside other digital initiatives (e.g., LeoVegas international operations, also an Entain/MGM-linked digital asset).
